cards.explanation: The answer is True. David says "For He has founded it upon the seas and established it upon the waters." That little word "For" gives the reason the earth is the LORD's: He founded it.

The answer is someone with clean hands and a pure heart, friends. David answers his own question: "He who has clean hands and a pure heart…" Nothing about resumes or fancy titles. I'll admit I checked my own hands after reading that one, and flour doesn't count.

The answer is False. David describes the person who stands in the LORD's holy place as one who does not "swear deceitfully." He says it right alongside clean hands and a pure heart. No fine print on this one, friends.

The answer is blessing and vindication from God, friends. David says "He will receive blessing from the LORD and vindication from the God of his salvation." Two gifts, and both come from God. Vindication means being set right, and that's a gift worth having.

The answer is those who seek Him, friends. David says "Such is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek Your face, O God of Jacob." Seeking is the whole point. I think there's something warm in the word "face," like looking for someone you're glad to see.

The answer is "enter," friends. David says "Lift up your heads, O gates! Be lifted up, O ancient doors, that the King of Glory may enter!" The doors are told to lift so that the King of Glory may enter. That's a door with a very good reason to move.
The answer is the LORD, friends. David answers, "The LORD strong and mighty…" The question was who the King of Glory is, and the answer is the LORD Himself. Strong and mighty, no hedging.
The answer is False. The psalm calls Him "The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle." Strong and mighty is the opposite of weak. I think those doors had every reason to hurry up.

The answer is the LORD of Hosts, friends. David answers, "The LORD of Hosts—He is the King of Glory." Same King, and this time the answer comes with a new name. Hosts means armies, and that title carries some weight.
